Andhra Pradesh clears investment proposals worth over ₹22,000 crore

The Andhra Pradesh State Investment Promotion Board (SIPB) has cleared investment proposals totaling ₹22,178 crore. The Chief Minister directed officials to ensure that construction work on all projects approved by the SIPB begins within six months. One report specified that projects worth ₹526 crore were cleared, which are expected to create 8,896 jobs.
